none: PAS NLM-A3DBC2: Roman Coin: Nummus, possibly of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, possibly of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 16.3mm, Weight: 1.72gms, die axis: 6
